notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Rampaging Baloths, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield as a Saproling due to Maskwood Nexus, which also causes it to be a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
